final_notes:
SETTLED: Score = sum of per-block points / taller tower height. Exact block 1, one matching attribute 0.25. Missing or extra blocks raise the divisor.
SETTLED: Max 8 words, so targets over 8 blocks lose their tail (a 9-block target capped at 8 here).
SETTLED: kuru=red, tumu=purple, fuza=blue, kano=yellow, dobo=green, melu=orange. Colour words held with a fourth partner (dobo kano dobo kano kano dobo tumu tumu gave the right colours).
SETTLED: One colour word builds one block. A shape word right after a colour modifies that block and adds none. Star is the default for unknown shape words. Colour-only messages score 1.00 on star targets and about 0.25 per block on non-star targets, so ball-heavy targets cap near 0.4 with colours alone.
SETTLED: tido=ring, shared across partners. Colour + tido costs 2 words for 1 block. Tido only affects the block it follows. A bare colour after it gives a star.
NOT WORKING: vonu failed with two partners (cube targets). Stop using it. vepu failed once.
OPEN: Words for cube, ball and cone are unknown. Untested candidates: mape, neto, fidi, muva, nove, zeki, loku. Balls appear in most targets, so finding the ball word is the biggest gain.
OPEN: Whether any shape word other than tido is shared between partners. Probably only tido.
NEXT as speaker: on short targets (4 blocks or fewer), put one untested shape word (neto, mape, fidi) after a colour on a ball block and check what gets built, then compare with the target. On long targets, use bare colours in target order, one word per block, tido only on ring blocks, keeping colour groups in proportion.
NEXT as builder: build one block per colour word. Read tido as ring. Treat other shape words as star, but note which word appeared where so I can compare with the target afterwards.

SETTLED: Score is 1 per block with colour and shape both matching, 0.25 if only one matches, divided by the taller tower's height.
SETTLED: Reading is left to right, bottom to top, max 8 words, so targets over 8 blocks lose their top blocks.
SETTLED (earlier partner, recheck with new one): colour words are kuru red, dobo green, tumu purple, kano yellow, melu orange, fuza blue.
SETTLED (earlier partner): each colour word makes one block, and a bare colour gives a star. Repeating a colour only adds blocks. Latest round: dobo kano dobo kano kano dobo tumu tumu gave 8 stars in those colours, so colour-only messages get 0.25 on every non-star block.
SETTLED (earlier partner): tido right after a colour makes that block a ring and adds no block. vonu does nothing.
OPEN: Words for ball, cone and cube are still unknown.
OPEN: Untested as shapes: nove, zeki, mape, fidi, muva, neto, loku, vepu.
OPEN: Whether the shape word must come right after its colour.
OPEN: Whether the new partner reads words the same way as the old one.
NOT WORKING: Colour-only messages for non-star targets, tido for ball, vonu for cube, repeated colours for shape, long runs for tall towers.
NEXT as describer: Use colour then shape word per block. Bare colour for stars, colour tido for rings. For ball, cone and cube, test one untested word right after a colour, e.g. kano nove, and check what is built. Use at most one test word per message, so the result is clear. Keep the first 8 blocks as the priority.
NEXT as builder: One block per colour word. A tido after a colour makes a ring. If an untested word follows a colour, build a star and record the word. Check whether the new partner's words match the old ones.
